decisions.reason: Glass-silicon wafers with through-glass vias are a core technology for Plan Optik's MEMS and packaging customers and fit its specialized wafer business.
Carrier wafers are a simple extension of the existing glass wafer portfolio, cost little to keep offering, and serve ongoing customer handling needs.
Cu-interposer glass wafers address the growing advanced-packaging market, and the firm promoted them prominently in 2019, so it will likely keep developing them despite a slow ramp-up.
The Wafer Universe off-the-shelf brand reuses existing production and opens an easy sales channel, so dropping it gains little.
Glass-based circuit boards are a more speculative application, but they share the same via and metallization technology, so the firm will likely keep offering them.
